episodes.title: A Serious Talk About the Cult we Grew up in (Not ASMR)
episodes.description:
This is a video about religious grooming and rape culture. 
To put it simply, I'm pretty sure I was groomed to be a predator growing up.  
And that's upsetting.

It was never straightforward. But when is grooming ever straightforward?

It was a combo of a few things I was taught:
- All sins are equal
- Judging someone is worse than sin
- "Looking upon a woman with lust" is equivalent to SA
- If you're born male, it's assumed you will experience lust.
Plus, the fact I never learned about consent or boundaries from any of my religious education.

This combination of dogmas creates an incentive for men to identify with, and protect predators.  It creates an incentive for men to build a community that protects predators.
It's like how capitalism convinces people to reason like a billionaire.
The brand of Christian evangelicalism I was raised in, convinces people to think like a predator.
